scripts.build: bun run --filter client build && bun run --filter agent build
scripts.package:macos: bun run build:client && bun run embed && bun build packages/agent/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/review-app-macos
scripts.package:windows: bun run build:client && bun run embed && bun build packages/agent/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile=dist/review-app-windows.exe
